summary: Official Nantong/Tongzhou sources evidence a local cadastral and real-estate-registration custodian and a public geospatial platform, but no anonymous public parcel ID plus polygon response was verified. No sample GeoJSON is retained; runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Simplified-Chinese discovery queries with actual result URLs are recorded in city-11646-tongzhou.json. The native-language query directly identified the Tongzhou cadastral-survey/cadastral-map procurement notice and official registration procedure.
requestOutcomes: TLS-verified bounded GETs found the Jiangsu registration portal at HTTP 200 with procedure navigation only; Nantong public data returned ACL HTTP 403. First-party indexed pages supplied custodial/procedure evidence but no exposed parcel API route. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request or TLS disablement was used.
scopeLimits: Exact WUP point [32.0756834083008, 121.069037390254] was preserved in latitude/longitude order and never shifted; no exact-point hit/miss inference was made.
No Tongzhou city boundary or complete city coverage was established for an open geometry service.
No parcel geometry, stable native parcel identity, source schema or CRS was retrieved or retained.
Local registry/procedure and procurement evidence is not proof of an open vector parcel API.
A timeout, ACL/WAF/login wall, map extent miss or unusable UI is not evidence of citywide cadastral absence.
No owner, address, titleholder, contact, tax/account or other personal/sensitive fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is research evidence only and does not qualify or admit a runtime adapter; serial reviewer qualification remains pending.
